name: Time-series Analysis
description: A detailed report for trends, period-over-period change, seasonality, and anomalies across an ordered time dimension.

data_requirements.description: One or more measures aggregated over a consistent time grain.
calculation_hints: Select a grain appropriate to the requested period.
Fill or explicitly mark missing periods before calculating growth.

fallback.message: A time-series report cannot be produced without an ordered time dimension and at least two periods.

data_requirements.description: Absolute and percentage change between consecutive or comparable periods.
calculation_hints: Do not calculate percentage change when the prior value is zero.

fallback.message: Omit change metrics when fewer than two comparable periods exist.

data_requirements.description: Time points whose values materially differ from the local or expected pattern.
calculation_hints: Expose the detection method and threshold in lineage metadata.
Treat anomalies as observations, not causes.

fallback.message: Omit anomaly markers when no reliable detection method is available.

sections.title: Trend Summary
sections.purpose: Summarize direction, magnitude, turning points, and data coverage.

blocks.title: Trend Metrics
instructions: Include start, end, minimum, maximum, and overall change when available.
Distinguish sustained trends from single-period movement.

sections.title: Trend Detail
sections.purpose: Visualize the full series without overwhelming the reader.

blocks.title: Measure Over Time

chart_slot.intent: Display the primary measure across time and preserve the correct chronological order.

fallback.message: Show the ordered time-series values in a table.

instructions: Prefer downsampling over dropping the oldest periods when the series exceeds max_points.

chart_slot.intent: Show positive and negative period-over-period changes around a zero baseline.

fallback.message: Omit the change chart when comparable periods are unavailable.

sections.title: Anomalies and Caveats
sections.purpose: Surface unusual observations and document limitations without asserting unsupported causes.

blocks.title: Anomaly Candidates

chart_slot.intent: Highlight candidate anomalous time points in the context of the observed series.

fallback.message: No reliable anomaly candidates were produced.

instructions: Label points as candidates unless a domain rule confirms an anomaly.
Report missing periods, incomplete latest periods, and changes in time grain.
